description: This file is a PHP unit test class for testing the PayGradeAPI class in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It specifically tests various API endpoints related to PayGrade entities such as retrieving all pay grades, retrieving a specific pay grade, creating, updating, and deleting pay grades. The test class uses data providers and mock services to validate functionality.

classes.name: PayGradeAPITest
